title: Processing code for the CH-TAN wheat 2023-24 flux product
description:
Jupyter notebooks and R scripts that produce the CH-TAN wheat 2023-24 flux product (version FP2026.10): half-hourly eddy covariance fluxes of CO2, H2O, sensible and latent heat, N2O and CH4, meteorological data and management information of a winter wheat field (17 October 2023 to 22 August 2024) at the Swiss FluxNet cropland site CH-TAN, Tänikon, Switzerland.

Processing: quality control with diive (levels 2 to 3.2), u* threshold detection, MDS gap-filling and flux partitioning with REddyProc, attribution of the fluxes to two parcels by wind direction (split footprint), and XGBoost gap-filling of NEE, N2O and CH4 fluxes with uncertainty estimates.

The data (raw input data and flux product) are published in the ETH Research Collection, doi:10.3929/ethz-c-000807457.
